compiled_state.title: Wire fixture-driven correctness test into calibration-rollup.yml CI and M2 release gate
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What / Why

The sc-4 fixture-driven correctness test (from story 9525, task 733e) must run in two places:
1. In CI via calibration-rollup.yml — as a pre-check step before any mutation-append or churn-append step
2. Locally as part of the M2 release gate (validate.sh --ci or equivalent pre-merge check)

This task wires both integration points. The test itself is already created (test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh from task 733e). This task adds the CI step reference in calibration-rollup.yml and the local gate entry.

## Files to Modify / Create

- .github/workflows/calibration-rollup.yml — EDIT: add pre-check step in pr-metrics job that runs test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh before mutation-append/churn-append; step name: 'Fixture correctness check'; job fails (not skips) if test exits non-zero
- .claude/scripts/dso-validate-calibration.sh or equivalent local gate — CREATE OR EDIT: add invocation of test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh so it runs during validate.sh --ci; chmod +x if new file; ensure it is referenced from validate.sh or docs/M2-gate procedure
- tests/scripts/test-calibration-rollup-fixture-gate.sh — CREATE: asserts calibration-rollup.yml contains the pre-check step invoking test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh before mutation-append; validates --ci local gate references the test

## Story DD Coverage

- dd-5: fixture-driven correctness test from sc-4 runs in CI via calibration-rollup.yml before any append step and is invoked as part of M2 release gate locally

## Given / When / Then (test approach)

Given calibration-rollup.yml with pre-check step
When test-calibration-rollup-fixture-gate.sh checks YAML step order
Then 'test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh' step appears before mutation-append step in pr-metrics job

Given local gate script exists
When test checks gate script contents
Then 'test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh' is referenced

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: calibration-rollup.yml pr-metrics job has pre-check step running test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh
- AC2: Pre-check step is ordered BEFORE mutation-append and churn-append steps (CI fails early on fixture regression)
- AC3: Local gate (validate.sh --ci path or named script) invokes test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh
- AC4: Structural test validates AC1-AC3

## Testing Mode

RED — CI step does not yet exist in calibration-rollup.yml (depends on 8070)

## Retry Budget

3

comments.body:
Gap analysis AC amendments:
(1) YAML edit safety: after editing calibration-rollup.yml, validate file still parses as YAML and preserves trigger structure from 8070. Structural test must pin pre-check step as FIRST step in pr-metrics job (step index 0 or named ordering), not just 'present before append'.
(2) Gate script decision: prefer dedicated .claude/scripts/dso-validate-calibration.sh invoked FROM validate.sh --ci rather than editing validate.sh directly (blast radius control). Specify exit-code propagation contract. Structural test must assert whichever path is chosen (non-tautological).
